records.title: DEVELOPMENT OF COAL GASIFICATION INFRASTRUCTURE
details:
As on date, approximately 22.6 
Million Tonnes Per Annum (MTPA) of coal gasification capacity is operational or under 
implementation, comprising:
(ii) Talcher Fertilisers Limited (TFL): ~2.6 MTPA (under implementation) 
(iii) 8 Projects under the ₹8,500 crore Financial Incentive Scheme: ~12 MTPA (under 
implementation)
